_about: Scenes for the adult studio. Edit freely and add your own (a new line with a unique id, a label, a level and the text). 'level' is what the picture is filed under: off = everyday, romantic, suggestive, explicit. Altera only sends a ready-made picture when adult mode is at that level or higher, and refuses to import one whose description needs a HIGHER level than it is filed under (for example 'lingerie' filed as romantic). Write each scene so it finishes the sentence 'Show the same woman from the reference image ...': what she is doing, where, what is worn, the look. One person only. No pronouns in the text, so every character can use them. Suggestive and explicit scenes are made as full-length photographs, so the whole body shows (add "frame": "auto" to a scene to keep the portrait's closer crop). Up to 16 pictures can be made at once. The hard rules (adults only, no minors or childlike details, no real people, nothing non-consensual) are checked in safety.py and cannot be edited here. The explicit scenes are solo poses and nudity; add your own to go further, or type one in 'Your own scene' in the studio.
